title: Unit Capacity Cost Control
description: Configurable linear capacity-cost scaling for Nagash, Chaos Dwarfs, Armies of Shang-Yang, Beastmen, and Empire Amethyst units. Applies only to players.

sections.beastmen: Beastmen / Units and three hero types

enabled.tooltip: Disable this to follow the current vanilla capacity-cost rules.

mode.tooltip: The percentage is applied linearly to the base cost for each recorded purchase.

custom.tooltip: Used only in Custom mode. Enter a finite number greater than 0.

base_cost_percent.tooltip: Used while override is enabled. 100% retains the base cost; 0% makes all capacity purchases free. Accepts finite, non-negative numbers, including decimals.

necromancy_progress_percent.tooltip: Progress uses the full vanilla cost of this capacity purchase, independently of base cost and custom scaling settings. Defaults to 100%; 0% contributes no progress.

light.tooltip: Increase capacity cost by 5% per purchase.

medium.tooltip: Increase capacity cost by 10% per purchase.

custom.tooltip: Use the positive custom percentage below.

validation.custom_invalid: Enter a finite number greater than 0.
validation.percent_invalid: Enter a finite number greater than or equal to 0.

debug.tooltip: Writes diagnostics to tww3_mod_capacity_cost_control_log.txt in the game directory.
debug.layout_note: Rate changes recalculate from the complete purchase history.

links.repository_tooltip: Open the GitHub repository via Steam’s external-link confirmation page.
